headline: Google gives Gemini computer-use ability on the Mac
summary: Google's Gemini app for macOS now has a computer-use feature that can perform multistep tasks such as organizing files, filling out forms and working across local files, desktop apps and the web. Google suggests it could help speed up workflows, fill in forms, make presentations and list items for sale.
